property_summary: For any caller that is not the current owner, calling transferOwnership must never change owner; the buggy version removes the onlyOwner check, so any caller can set owner to a new value.

For any address actor, after ownership is transferred to actor and owned() is invoked by that actor, the stored owner must remain unchanged by owned() (owned() must not mutate ownership); the mutant overwrites owner inside owned(), and although here it only assigns msg.sender, the rule 'owned() does not change c.owner()' is the invariant the fuzzer-driven call checks.

For every possible caller, invoking owned() must either revert or leave ownership untouched: no input can make the owner getter return anything other than the value established by transferOwnership (initially address(0)); the mutant overwrites owner with msg.sender inside owned(), so a call that reaches the body seizes/rewrites ownership, breaking the freeze rule for some caller.

For any caller, driving the contract through owned() must leave the ownership state readable via c.owner() exactly as last established by transferOwnership; owned() must be ownership-neutral, whereas the mutant overwrites owner with msg.sender inside owned().

For any fuzzed actor, after ownership is transferred to that actor and they invoke owned(), the stored owner must remain exactly that transferred address and no non-owner caller may alter it; the mutant overwrites owner with msg.sender inside owned(), so a call reaching the body rewrites ownership and breaks the freeze rule.

After the owner is explicitly transferred to any fuzzed actor, invoking owned() must be ownership-neutral: c.owner() remains exactly the address established by transferOwnership; the mutant overwrites owner inside owned(), so a call reaching the body rewrites ownership and breaks this invariant.

For any caller who is the current owner, transferOwnership(newOwner) must always complete and leave owner() == newOwner for every newOwner, including address(0); the mutant reverts when newOwner == address(0), leaving owner unchanged.
